scientific_limitations: Exact geometric all-one coefficient polynomial and representable \(x=1-2^{-q}\), one fused rounding per Horner step, truncation-based limited-bit operator, normal binary arithmetic, sufficiently wide exponent range.

title: Sharp random-bit barrier for fused Horner evaluation of a geometric polynomial
